params.name: AudioCodec
params.notes: Optional. Specify a audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension. Options: aac, mp3, vorbis, wma.

params.name: EnableAutoStreamCopy
params.notes: Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.

params.name: AudioSampleRate
params.notes: Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100

params.name: AudioBitRate
params.notes: Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.

params.name: AudioChannels
params.notes: Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2

params.name: MaxAudioChannels
params.notes: Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2

params.name: Static
params.notes: Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false

params.name: CopyTimestamps
params.notes: Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.

params.name: StartTimeTicks
params.notes: Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1ms = 10000 ticks.

params.name: Width
params.notes: Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.

params.name: Height
params.notes: Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.

params.name: MaxWidth
params.notes: Optional. The maximum horizontal resolution of the encoded video.

params.name: MaxHeight
params.notes: Optional. The maximum vertical resolution of the encoded video.

params.name: VideoBitRate
params.notes: Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.

params.name: SubtitleStreamIndex
params.notes: Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.

params.name: SubtitleMethod
params.notes: Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.

params.name: MaxVideoBitDepth
params.notes: Optional.

params.name: VideoCodec
params.notes: Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension. Options: h264, mpeg4, theora, vpx, wmv.

params.name: AudioStreamIndex
